label: Apply for a License or a Permit

componentAttributes.richTextValue:
Apply for a License or Permit

Apply online, pay with PayStar and upload your documents.

Choose the application you need. You can save an application and finish it later from My Applications; saved applications are kept for 30 days.

Apply for Reciprocity Transfer a cosmetology, esthetician, manicurist or instructor license from another state or country, including military reciprocity.
Retake an Exam Retake the national, practical or state exam for a reciprocity application.
Apply for a Temporary Permit A 30-day permit for people licensed in another state, for an event in Louisiana. Apply at least 30 days before the event.
Apply for a Threading Permit For people who thread facial hair and hold no cosmetology or esthetics license. Includes the 15-question sanitation exam.
Request an Affidavit A certification of your Louisiana license for another state's board. The first is free.
Apply for a Shop License For a new cosmetology, manicuring, esthetics or home care salon, a new location, a reopening or a new owner.
Apply for a Facility License For a threading or alternative hair design (AHD) facility.

Other applications are on the Forms & Resources page until they are available online.
